ValidationRule.description: Prevents editing key fields on closed opportunities
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR(ISCHANGED(Amount), ISCHANGED(StageName), ISCHANGED(CloseDate)), OR(ISPICKVAL(PriorValue(StageName), 'Closed Won'), ISPICKVAL(PriorValue(StageName), 'Closed Lost')) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Closed opportunities cannot be edited. Reopen the opportunity first.
